patients.summary: Healthy elementary school teacher who joins the practice at 27. After her first delivery in 2022 she develops autoimmune Addison disease and a right lactational mastitis that becomes an abscess needing drainage; a second uncomplicated delivery in 2025 leaves a diastasis recti.

documents.title: New Patient Call
documents.author: front desk
documents.body: Caller moved to Northampton over the summer, teaches at an elementary school in town, wants a doctor she can actually reach. Explained membership and that insurance still covers labs and specialists (BCBS PPO). Booked new patient physical 9/9 at 9:00. She signed the records release over the phone-fax form sent to her email; request faxed to her previous primary care office. Asked her to fast for labs.

documents.title: New Patient Preventive Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
27 y/o woman establishing care. Moved here this summer, 1st grade/2nd grade split classroom at a local elementary school. No complaints today. Feels well.

PMH: none. PSH: none. Meds: none, no supplements. Allergies: NKDA.
OB/GYN: G0. Regular cycles. Not currently trying to conceive, may in the next couple of years. Last Pap 2016 normal per old records.
FHx: mother - autoimmune hypothyroidism. Maternal aunt - rheumatoid arthritis. Paternal cousin - type 1 diabetes. No known cardiac disease or cancer.
SH: married, never smoked, doesn't drink, no drugs. Walks most days, some yoga.
Immunizations: HPV complete, Tdap 2014. Will get flu shot when available.

ROS: negative x 12 systems.

Exam: vitals as recorded, BMI about 23. Well appearing. HEENT normal, TM clear, oropharynx clear. Neck supple, thyroid normal size without nodules. Lungs clear. Heart regular, no murmur. Abdomen soft, no masses. Breasts: symmetric, no masses, no nipple discharge, no axillary nodes. Pelvic: normal external genitalia, cervix without lesions, Pap collected, bimanual normal. Skin: no rashes, no unusual pigmentation. Neuro nonfocal. Mood bright.

A/P: Healthy adult, preventive visit.
- Pap today (due, 3 years since last)
- CBC, CMP, lipids, TSH (family history of autoimmune thyroid disease), one-time HIV and hep C screen
- Discussed folic acid if she starts trying to conceive
- Flu shot in October
- RTC 1 year

documents.title: Your Lab Results
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Hi Kayla, everything from Monday came back in good shape: blood counts, kidneys, liver, sugar and thyroid all normal, and your cholesterol numbers are fine. HIV and hepatitis C screens negative (we only need to do those once). Pap result will take a few more days and I'll send it along. Welcome to the practice!

documents.title: Pap Result
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Pap smear normal. Next one in 3 years, or sooner if your OB does one with a pregnancy.

documents.title: Immunization Visit
documents.author: RN
documents.body: Here after school for flu vaccine. No fever today, no prior vaccine reactions, not pregnant. Quadrivalent flu 0.5 mL IM R deltoid. VIS provided. Tolerated without issue, left ambulatory.

documents.title: Immunization Record
documents.author: patient
documents.body: Hi, the district HR office is asking all of us to upload an updated immunization record before next year (even though we're all remote right now). Could you put one in the portal? Thanks, Kayla

documents.title: RE: Immunization Record
documents.author: MA
documents.body: Hi Kayla, your immunization summary (including the records from your prior office and last fall's flu shot) is now under Documents in the portal. Let us know if HR needs a signed copy.

documents.title: Annual Preventive Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Annual. Masked visit. Back in the classroom with hybrid schedule, tiring but fine. No health concerns. No meds. NKDA. Not trying to conceive yet, thinking next year.

Exam: BP and weight as recorded, weight up half a kilo. Well appearing. Thyroid normal. Lungs clear, heart regular. Abd benign. Skin normal.

Plan: routine labs. Flu shot next month. Folic acid once trying. Pap not due until 2022. RTC 1 yr.

documents.title: Lab Results
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Labs all normal. See you for flu shot.

documents.title: Immunization Visit
documents.author: RN
documents.body: Flu vaccine, quadrivalent, 0.5 mL IM L deltoid. Screened: afebrile, no COVID symptoms, no exposures. Tolerated well.

documents.title: COVID vaccine
documents.author: patient
documents.body: Teachers are eligible starting this week. Is there any reason I shouldn't get it if we might try for a baby later this year? I can get an appointment at a pharmacy.

documents.title: RE: COVID vaccine
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Go ahead and get it. No reason to delay trying to conceive after vaccination, and being protected before pregnancy is a good thing. Send me the dates when you're done and we'll add them to your chart.

documents.author: pharmacy
documents.body: Patient-uploaded photo of CDC vaccination card plus pharmacy administration record. Pfizer-BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine dose 1 on 04/06/2021 and dose 2 on 04/27/2021, both IM left deltoid. Entered into immunization history by MA.

medications.sig: Take 1 tablet by mouth daily (over the counter)

documents.title: Annual Preventive Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Kayla is in for her yearly before school starts back. She plans to start trying for a pregnancy this winter, and she wanted to go over anything she should do ahead of time.

Currently no meds. NKDA. Fully vaccinated for COVID (April). Never smoker, no alcohol.
FHx unchanged - mother hypothyroid, aunt RA, cousin T1DM.
ROS negative. Cycles regular.

Exam: vitals as charted. Well, thyroid not enlarged. Heart/lungs normal. Abdomen soft. Skin without rashes or pigment change.

Assessment/plan
1. Preconception: start folic acid 0.4 mg daily now (OTC, or a prenatal vitamin with that amount). Reviewed avoiding alcohol (already abstains), food safety, keeping flu and COVID up to date. Rubella and varicella immunity will be checked by OB with first prenatal labs. Call when positive test and we'll get her set up with OB.
2. Thyroid: TSH today given mother's autoimmune thyroid disease.
3. Health maintenance: Pap up to date (2019). Flu in the fall. Booster when eligible.
RTC 1 year or when pregnant.

documents.title: Lab Results
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Thyroid normal, blood count normal, chemistries normal. All good for planning ahead.

documents.title: Immunization Visit
documents.author: MA
documents.body: Flu quadrivalent 0.5 mL IM R deltoid, lot recorded in vaccine log. Pt denies illness today. Not pregnant per pt. Observed 15 min, no reaction.

documents.title: Booster
documents.author: patient
documents.body: Got my booster Friday afternoon at the pharmacy downtown (Pfizer again). Sore arm and tired on Saturday, fine now. Card photo attached.

documents.title: RE: Booster
documents.author: MA
documents.body: Thanks Kayla, booster dated 12/10/2021 added to your record.
